review_locator: PMCID:PMC4626643, Opposing Roles of Interferon-Gamma on Cells of the Central Nervous System in Autoimmune Neuroinflammation; PMCID:PMC4618768, Control of autoimmune CNS inflammation by astrocytes
primary_title: IFN-gamma-induced chemokines synergize with pertussis toxin to promote T cell entry to the central nervous system
decision_basis: The reviews identify IFN-gamma-dependent CNS glial chemokine induction; the cited primary shows IFN-gamma-driven CCL5/RANTES message in the CNS, with IFN-gamma receptor dependence and localization to meningeal, ependymal, astrocyte, and microglial compartments.
limitations_preserved: CNS chemokine transcription in an intrathecal IFN-gamma model; preserve IFN-gamma-receptor dependence and the finding that chemokine induction alone was insufficient for inflammation, distinguish CCL5 transcript from released protein and CCR5 signaling, and do not infer SCI weighting or terminal-TF output.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC2674015, Toll-like Receptors: Novel Pharmacological Targets for the Treatment of Neurological Diseases; PMCID:PMC4618768, Control of autoimmune CNS inflammation by astrocytes
primary_title: Preferential expression and function of Toll-like receptor 3 in human astrocytes
decision_basis: The reviews identify cytokine regulation of astrocyte innate-sensing receptors; the cited primary shows that IFN-gamma enhances TLR3 mRNA in cultured human astrocytes.
limitations_preserved: Priming/expression edge only; preserve human astrocyte and subsequent poly(I:C) requirement, and do not infer that IFN-gamma alone activates TLR3 signaling, a TLR3 protein-quantity edge, SCI weighting, or terminal-TF output.
